title: Brilliant & simple
body:
This app is a wonderful support for making thoughtful use of one’s time. In particular, I find the Split View interface, where I can review lists with major longer term projects, things I want to do most days, and delights I’d like to make space for most weeks, alongside today’s uncommitted time slots. 
I don’t use TimeFinder for detailed notes on what to do on each project - I keep that information in other apps. Where this app is superb is in managing the interface between to do lists and calendars. Very highly recommended if working out how to weave long term priorities into busy days and weeks is your challenge.
